items: AI improves restaurant workflows only when you apply it to the right problem, so start with the bottleneck that hurts speed and consistency most across your stores.
Voice AI can take drive-thru and phone orders during a rush and catch errors before they reach the kitchen.
Demand forecasts from your sales history help you match staffing to actual traffic and order and prep only what sells, which cuts food waste.
AI can reply to reviews and messages across every location and show which stores have a service or quality issue before it spreads across the brand.
